title: Lenny Winnemuller
text:
I started my career as a professional trader at an Amsterdam-based proprietary trading firm. After strong results in the Peak Capital Trading bootcamp, I earned a seat at Andrew Aziz's firm, Peak Capital Trading.

Today I invest independently for the long term and teach long-term investing in a Canadian trader education program. Years of working in the markets taught me what really makes the difference: not the next big idea, but discipline, a clear process and control over your own behaviour.

That is where my academic background comes in. I graduated with honours in Psychology from the University of Amsterdam, specialising in emotion, performance and group behaviour, and I also hold a degree in entrepreneurship.

My mission is to provide honest and responsible financial education, so students learn to invest independently for the long term, while enjoying the process of learning about the economy, the philosophy of investing and their own psychology.
section_title: Why I teach investing as a skill
section_text:
Long-term investing isn't about finding the next big idea, rather it's a skill. Making good decisions, consistently, for years. Like any skill, it can be developed and learned, but it takes the right method, deliberate practice and someone who gives you honest feedback along the way.

I never tell anyone what to buy or give buy recommendations. I teach you how to make your own well formed decisions, so you never have to believe any story again.
